gloss: first volume; upper volume (of a two- or three-part work)

definitions.explanation: The first volume of a book or work published in two or three parts. The pairing is {上巻|じょうかん} / {下巻|げかん} for two-part works, or {上巻|じょうかん} / {中巻|ちゅうかん} / {下巻|げかん} for three.

examples.japanese: {上巻|じょうかん}を{先|さき}に{読|よ}んだ。
examples.english: I read the first volume first.

examples.japanese: この{小説|しょうせつ}は{上巻|じょうかん}と{下巻|げかん}に{分|わ}かれている。
examples.english: This novel is divided into a first volume and a second volume.

examples.japanese: {上巻|じょうかん}の{結末|けつまつ}が{衝撃的|しょうげきてき}で、すぐに{下巻|げかん}を{読|よ}みたくなった。
examples.english: The ending of the first volume was shocking, and I immediately wanted to read the second.

notes:
Used for books published in two or three physical volumes. The pair is {下巻|げかん} (second volume); for three-part sets, {中巻|ちゅうかん} (middle volume) is added in between.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上巻|じょうかん}を{読|よ}む: read the first volume
- {上巻|じょうかん}・{下巻|げかん}: first and second volumes (set notation)
- {上巻|じょうかん}{発売中|はつばいちゅう}: first volume on sale now

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {下巻|げかん}: second / last volume — the pair of {上巻|じょうかん}
- {第一巻|だいいっかん}: volume 1 — used for numbered series of any length
- {前編|ぜんぺん}: first part — used more for stories told in installments (films, articles)
